name: com.tomergoldst.timekeeper.core.WakeOnAlarmIntentService
description: The TimeKeeper alarm scheduling SDK by Tomer Goldstein starts this Service when a scheduled alarm fires, or to restore saved alarms after device startup or an app update. It processes due alarms and notifies the app.
disableEffect: Disabling this Service stops TimeKeeper from delivering scheduled alarm events or restoring saved alarms after startup or an app update, so scheduled app actions may be missed.
